about.title: About Sparfuchs Berlin
about.intro: Sparfuchs Berlin compares the weekly offers of the big supermarkets. An offer is only matched to a product when it really is that product, and compared per kilo, litre or piece.
about.dataSourcesText: Offers come from rewe.de, penny.de, aldi-nord.de and kaufland.de and are fetched daily at 05:00. Expired offers disappear automatically.
about.disclaimerText: All prices without guarantee. Actual in-store prices may differ. This is not an official service of the stores named.
